starting_evidence: Thirteen executed actual slots through 26 October; earlier single consumed-slot feasibility is exploratory input, not independent validation.
mechanics: Use the original sixty-return shrinkage covariance and the actual pre-slot state, observed book, precision, fee and adverse slippage model.
Respect risk and paired market vetoes when projecting the already proposed quantity vector.
Reprice complete per-symbol orders from the original pre-slot state for each trial; never reuse already-consumed depth as another order.
Only consider one contract less in absolute quantity on the currently higher forecast-risk arm.
Accept only a strict relative-gap improvement that does not increase that arm forecast risk; choose lowest gap with symbol lexical tie-break.
Stop within the existing two-percent tolerance; do not increase quantities, change signs, extend the universe, or target subsequent profit.
Bound the walk to 1000 iterations; lack of a permitted improving move is an algorithmic non-solution, not proof of mathematical infeasibility.
Missing funding, partial execution, invalid input, one-sided zero risk or unresolved matching must not receive a qualification pass. Never flatten both portfolios merely to obtain a pass.
historical_method: Independent one-slot engineering contexts only. Reconstruct the unmodified actual path and retain all original outcomes. Never propagate a corrected context into another historical slot.
change_control: Any eventual operational allocation change needs qualification, an explicitly declared new future version boundary and operator authorization; original observations are never reclassified.
